_comment: The completion gate (docs/CONTRACTS.md section 30): opt-in harness control at the end of a
turn, declared as `[verify] completion_gate` in policy.toml. Recorded as
`counters.completion_gate` on the turn record and TaskRecord, and as one `completion_gate`
audit record per end of a turn the gate judged. A readout parses these without reading the
code, so renaming a key, a mode, an action or an outcome is a contract change.
packages/gnomon-core/src/completion_gate.test.ts asserts the module against this file and
that CONTRACTS.md names the section, the kind and every value below.
completion_gate_loop.test.ts holds the off-by-default claim: with no gate declared, a
scripted turn sends request bodies whose sha256 matches master's.
